name: Assetz Sora & Saki
location: KIADB Hardware & IT Park, Devanahalli, Bengaluru
description: A community of seven residential towers on 11.28 acres inside the KIADB Hardware & IT Park near Devanahalli, a park that is home to over 400 companies. Assetz calls it a Carbon Healing Home, with design features it names Sponge Effect, Smart Power, Zero Out, and Climate Capsule.
curation: Homes inside an IT park with over 400 companies
About 11 km from Kempegowda International Airport
developerNote: Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Bengaluru, Assetz Property Group lists 50+ projects and over 50 million sq.ft of development in its portfolio.
